items.heading: A Skill Being "in Demand"
items.text: A skill being "in demand" is not the same as you being qualified in it. The gap between the two is exactly what the data is measuring.

items.heading: The Strongest Combination Is Deep
items.text: The strongest combination is deep domain knowledge plus AI direction, verification, communication, and workflow automation. That stack can multiply output dramatically, but only when it solves a real problem and produces proof another person can trust.

items.heading: Ai/ml Roles Carry More Than
items.text: AI/ML roles carry more than 290,000 open postings in India with a demand-supply gap of around 51%, according to NASSCOM data.
